methodHandling.otherMethods: Any non-POST -> 405 {"error":"Method not allowed"}, checked BEFORE auth (an unauthenticated GET gets 405, not 401).

auth.notes: After the method check, before body parse.

request.contentType: application/json (content-type header not checked; body parsed with req.json() regardless)
request.parse: await req.json() uncaught: malformed/empty JSON -> SyntaxError -> 500 {"error":"Internal error"}. JSON null -> destructuring TypeError -> 500 'Internal error'. JSON array/number/string -> fields undefined -> 400 'Missing params'.

fields.name: deckId
fields.bounds: truthy; no UUID check (non-UUID -> ownsDeck Postgres error -> 500)

fields.name: slide
fields.type: string (typed) - a JSON number also works
fields.bounds: parseInt(slide,10) must be integer > 0; '1abc' -> 1 accepted; numeric 0 or '' -> falsy -> 'Missing params'; '0'/'-1'/'abc' -> 'Invalid slide'

fields.name: version
fields.bounds: parseInt(version,10); refined iff integer >= 2; invalid/0/1 -> original image, no error

fields.name: applyBrandLayout
fields.bounds: only literal false disables; any other value (missing, 'false' string, 0, null) = ON

fields.name: variant
fields.validation: declared in the TS type but never read (legacy; frontend still sends 'A')

request.unknownFields: Ignored (e.g. Auxi_Connector sends 'heading', forge.py:803-806, which is silently dropped; the heading actually sent upstream is always the DB slide title).

checkOrder: 6. ownsDeck (403 'Not your deck') - before any brand asset read
7. getDeckWithSlides / resolveBrandSource / getSlideTypes - each error swallowed (.catch) and degraded to defaults
8. read slide PNG (refined key or original, each with legacy variant_A fallback) (404 'Image not found')
9. requireEnv PPTX_API_URL, PPTX_API_TOKEN (500 'Internal error' if missing)
10. build multipart form, load master PNG / furniture (readBrandAsset errors NOT caught -> 500; furniture read errors caught -> null)

errors.when: no PNG for that slide/version (new or legacy key)

body.error: Brand layout rejected by the PPTX service (invalid archetype or furniture).
Brand layout assets are too large for the PPTX service.

errors.when: malformed JSON body; JSON null body; non-UUID deckId; missing PPTX_API_URL/PPTX_API_TOKEN ('Missing required env var' Error is not an HttpError); fetch network failure; upstream 2xx with non-JSON body; brand master blob read failure

sideEffects: POST {PPTX_API_URL}/jobs creates a SlideForge conversion job (paid OCR/LLM upstream).
void incrementExportCounts(userId, deckId) only on success (rpc increment_export_counts).
externalCalls: POST ${PPTX_API_URL}/jobs, header Authorization: Bearer ${PPTX_API_TOKEN}, multipart/form-data (pptx-submit.ts:191-195). Fields: file (slide PNG, filename slide.png, image/png) always; slide_context (buildSlideContext string) when the slide row exists; primary_color, accent_color, heading_font, body_font (normalizeKit, with company from deck inputs) always; slide_framework when slide row has framework; chart_data JSON {chart_kind, categories, series} when storyline slide has chartData and framework meta is a chart with subType; language='ar' only for Arabic decks (pptx-submit.ts:92-104).

Brand layout fields only when the brand has a master PNG or furniture for the slide archetype: layout_archetype (cover|divider|content via archetypeForType: title->cover, divider->divider, else content), apply_brand_layout 'true'|'false', furniture_json (raw text of brand/{owner}/{brandId}/furniture.json) when kit.furnitureArchetypes includes the archetype, layout_template (master PNG, layout.png) + apply_template_bg 'true'|'false' when a master exists, heading (slide row title) when furniture present, date ('Month YYYY', en-US) for cover with furniture (pptx-submit.ts:141-179; _shared/brandKit.ts:118-122).

Master selection: cover->titleMaster if kit.titleMasterKey, divider->dividerMaster if kit.dividerMasterKey, else 'master' if kit.masterKey; keys always re-derived from brand owner id + deck brandId, never from kit strings; legacy per-user brand/{userId}/master.png fallback when no brandId, or when brand is personal (legacyOk) and the scoped master is missing (pptx-submit.ts:112-148).

Workzone tiles: tile_is_content_only='true' and workzone_bounds JSON when kit.workzone && shouldTileSlide (content archetype, non-degenerate workzone, furniture for content) (pptx-submit.ts:186-189; _shared/workzone.ts:116-120).
quirks: Success status is 200, not 202 (pptx-submit.ts:209), unlike image-to-slide (202).
applyBrandLayout defaults ON; only boolean false turns it off.
Unbranded decks: request to upstream is byte-for-byte the legacy one (no brand-layout fields) regardless of applyBrandLayout (tests).
deck data / brand / slide-type lookups failing are swallowed and degrade to defaults (pptx-submit.ts:35,37-38,46) - an export never fails because of them.
Upstream job id is not validated; missing job_id gives 200 {}.
Only 413/422 are passed through with mapped messages; upstream 400/401/404/429/5xx all become 502 'PPTX service error'.
The jobId returned is the SlideForge id; there is no ownership record, so /api/pptx-status and /api/pptx-result accept it from any authenticated user.
A request field 'heading' (sent by Auxi_Connector) is ignored; heading always comes from the slide row title.
Cover date uses the server clock/timezone at submit time (pptx-submit.ts:176).
beforeAnyState: Deck owned but slide image not rendered -> 404 'Image not found'. Deck missing -> 403. If getDeckWithSlides fails or returns no row for the slide, no slide_context/framework/heading is sent but the job still submits.

tests.asserts: All 11 pass (2026-10-08): unbranded deck sends no layout fields (200); applyBrandLayout:false sends furniture+template with apply_brand_layout/apply_template_bg 'false' and heading 'T'; false + no assets sends nothing extra; furniture_json inline + layout_archetype content + apply_brand_layout true; master -> layout_template + apply_template_bg true read from brand/u1/b-1/master.png; title slide -> cover + titleMaster; keys re-derived (never forged kit keys); language=ar forwarded / omitted for English; upstream 422 -> 422; non-owner -> 403 before any brand asset read. Tests use upstream status 202 with {job_id} and expect handler 200.

callers.expects: Sends {deckId, slide: String(n), variant:'A', version: String(v) only when v>1, applyBrandLayout}. Reads jobId. Non-2xx -> Error(body.error || 'HTTP <status>').

Sends {deckId, slide: str, applyBrandLayout: bool (default False), version?: str, heading?: str}. Status 413 and 422 mapped to specific user messages (forge.py:784-787); any other >=400 -> 'PPTX submit failed (<status>)'; 2xx must be JSON object with non-empty 'jobId'.

docs.openapi: public/openapi.yaml:966-1035 - matches fields and 200/413/422/502. Missing: 400 ('Missing params', 'Invalid slide'), 401, 403, 404, 405, 500 responses; deckId 'format: uuid' is not enforced.

planSection65: Row '/api/pptx-submit (POST) | {deckId, slide, version, applyBrandLayout} -> {jobId}' - accurate; specify status 200 (not 202), 405 before auth, 413/422 passthrough with fixed messages, 502 otherwise, and that 'variant'/'heading' are ignored.
